# dsar-export

> Assemble a data subject access request export from pluggable data sources: matched records, third-party redaction, a byte-reproducible ZIP with a SHA-256 manifest Python package `trysac-dsar-export`, import name `dsar_export`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
